title: Resolve production parts before canonical component binding
problem: Logical roles and local library candidates were reaching pilot artifacts without an exact live-selected MPN shared by schematic, PCB, BOM, and manufacturing evidence.
rootCause: Supplier selection, asset binding, and downstream projections were independent pipelines.
solution: Rank bounded approved part families using exact live supplier responses, cache briefly, retry transient failures, then content-address one canonical binding and derive every downstream projection from it.
limitations: A live exact supplier match does not prove an unapproved local symbol or footprint is production-correct.
Provider outage or missing exact part evidence blocks selection.
